caption: The drawing depicts a single object, specifically a whip with a combination of materials and textures. The whip features a looped, heavily braided section at the top, colored in shades of brown and tan. Attached to this braided portion is a long, dark brown leather lash that is slightly curved and textured, showing variations in tone. The handle of the whip is composed of a silvery metal cylinder with engraved patterns, flanked by segments wrapped in a darker, purple-brown braided material on each end. At the bottom of the handle, there is a narrow leather strap, also brown and with a woven appearance, featuring an embossed circular floral design and other decorative patterns. The entire composition is set against an off-white or light beige background, with no other objects present.
title: Rawhide Quirt
